[User Agreement]
Welcome to this software. It was made by the author; please do not steal or redistribute others' work.

1. By using this software you agree to this agreement.
2. This software is released as "Formal" and "Beta" versions. The beta version is for trying the latest features and collecting feedback and may contain unknown issues.
3. This software is only for learning and personal use. Any illegal use is prohibited.

[Version Overview]
- Formal (Stable): a verified stable version, suitable for daily use, e.g. v1.6.8.
- Beta: a preview version, e.g. v1.8.0.1-beta, for trying new features early and reporting issues. It may contain unknown issues or signature changes, so it is recommended to install it on a spare device.
- For the most stable experience, choose the formal version; the beta version is only for trying out.

[Privacy Policy]
This software is a purely local offline tool, with no data upload, no ads, and no third-party tracking.

1. We do NOT collect, store or upload any of your personal data.
2. File browsing, compression, APK processing and other operations are all done on your device.
3. The software only accesses GitHub to read version information for update prompts when you enable "Check for updates on startup". It does not upload any data.
4. You can disable version checking in Settings at any time to use it fully offline.

If you have any questions about this agreement or privacy policy, please give us feedback in the GitHub repository, or email: gexinggzs@163.com.

Since v1.7.0 the APK signing key has changed.

[Old versions v1.6.x and earlier]
Uses the old key, signing certificate subject:
CN=PK Manager, OU=PKTools, O=PKTools, L=Shenzhen, ST=Guangdong, C=CN

[New versions v1.7.0 and later]
Uses the new key alltoolbox.jks, signing certificate subject:
CN=AllToolbox, OU=AllToolbox, O=AllToolbox, L=X, ST=X, C=CN

[Impact and upgrade notes]
Android does not allow installing over an existing app with a different signature. If you have the old-signed version (v1.6.x or earlier) installed, installing the new version directly will show "Signature abnormal / App not installed / INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE".
Solution: uninstall the old version first, then install the new one (v1.7.0+).
(Uninstalling clears this app's local settings, bookmarks, vault and other data)

[Going forward] From v1.7.0 all versions are signed with the same AllToolbox key, so future sibling versions can be updated directly by overwriting and there will be no more signature issues.
